essence: A physically-plausible HDR bloom/glow. The brightest regions of the source bleed soft light outward (a threshold picks WHAT glows, radius sets HOW FAR, exposure sets HOW BRIGHT), composited back over the source. The go-to lens-bloom / neon-glow / dreamy-haze look — cleaner and softer than AE's native Glow, in the Trapcode-Glow / Optical-Glow class.
manifests_as: soft halos of light spreading out of the bright areas of the source — probe-confirmed (Exposure 0=off, 2=strong bloom, 6=blown white; Radius 1500=wide wash; Threshold 200=only brightest bloom)

key_levers.name: Exposure
key_levers.effect: MASTER glow brightness/intensity. 0 = glow off (source only), ~1-2 = natural bloom, ~3-5 = strong, 6+ = blows out to white. Probe-confirmed.

key_levers.name: Radius
key_levers.effect: size/reach of the glow. Low = tight halos hugging the highlights; high (1000-2000) = wide soft light-wash bleeding across the frame. Probe-confirmed.

key_levers.name: Threshold
key_levers.effect: luminance gate — WHICH pixels glow. 0 = everything glows (full-frame bloom); raise (100-300%) so only the brightest pixels (neon/highlights) bloom and the rest stays sharp. Probe-confirmed at 200%.

key_levers.name: Threshold Smooth
key_levers.effect: softness of the threshold cutoff — feathers the transition between glowing and non-glowing regions.

key_levers.name: Source Opacity
key_levers.effect: opacity of the original source under the glow. Lower toward 0 to fade the source and leave a glow-only / light-abstraction pass.

key_levers.name: Blend Mode
key_levers.effect: how the glow composites over the source (Add-like vs Screen-like); verify which index is which if a specific comp is needed.

enums_to_verify.View (PEDG-0023, 1-2): 1 = glow only, 2 = composite over source. Probe used default 2 (composite).
enums_to_verify.Blend Mode (PEDG-0008, 1-2): Add vs Screen compositing of the glow
enums_to_verify.Tint Mode (PEDG-0039, 1-3): how the optional glow Tint (enable PEDG-0037, color PEDG-0038) is applied
enums_to_verify.Chromatic Aberration Channels (PEDG-0014: which channels split when Chromatic Aberration (enable PEDG-0013, amount PEDG-0015) is on
enums_to_verify.Edge Behaviour (PEDG-0055, 1-4): how the glow treats the frame edge (bleed/clamp/wrap)

config_recipes.subtle soft light: Exposure 0.5-1, Radius 300-600, Threshold 30-60 — gentle bloom on highlights
config_recipes.dreamy heavy haze: Exposure 2-3, Radius 800-1500, Threshold 0-20 — full soft-focus wash
config_recipes.neon / highlight-only glow: Threshold 120-250, Exposure 2-4, Radius 400-700 — only the bright neon blooms, rest stays crisp
config_recipes.glow-only light pass: Source Opacity 0 (or View=glow-only), Exposure 2-4 — isolate the bloom to Add over a stack
config_recipes.blown-out flash / bright hit: Exposure 5-10 — clips toward white for an impact/transition

reasoning_hooks.only the bright parts should glow: raise Threshold (+ Threshold Smooth for a soft cutoff)

grounding: introspect card (85 leaf params, full SEMANTIC names + ranges + units — cards/PEDG.json) + 5-frame visual probe on a Fractal-Noise+Tint textured base (introspect/frames/ess_pedg_*: exp0 off / exp2 bloom / exp6 white; rad1500 wide wash; thr200 back to near-source) + model prior on Deep Glow / bloom effects. Confidence: high on the levers; medium on the untested Blend/Tint/CA enum indices.
_method: introspect + focused probe + synth (the essence-card pipeline)

unreachable_levers.name: Spread
unreachable_levers.advertised: range 0.01..100 percent, default 33 — shape/falloff of the glow
unreachable_levers.why: NOT WRITABLE in the default state on Deep Glow v1.5.5: the plugin exposes it to the scripting API (it reads back a value, range and units) but setValue throws 'the property or a parent property is hidden'. Six candidate gates were flipped (Blend Mode, Auto Iterations, View, Unmult, Fixed Steps, Enable Dither), on a fresh instance and after a render, and it stayed shut in every one. CAVEAT: that is evidence, not proof. The same single-gate method failed to open Trapcode Form's Base Form Size Y — which a shipped recipe demonstrably CAN set — so a negative gate probe does not establish permanence. Treat as unreachable until a gate is found; do not offer it as a lever.
unreachable_levers._probe: 2026-07-19 settability second pass + 6-gate flip probe; see introspect/SETTABILITY.md for the method's known blind spot

unreachable_levers.name: Glow Iterations
unreachable_levers.why: hidden — same probe (Auto Iterations does not unlock it)

_settability_note: Readable != writable. 9 of this effect's params report a name, range, units and current value through the scripting API yet reject every write in the default state. They are recorded here so the planner and the tune loop's co-lever list never spend a move on them. Measured, not assumed — but see the caveat on Spread: 'not writable now' is established, 'never writable' is not.
